content: Public keys for NIST and Brainpool ECC curves are provided with their X and Y coordinates: ECC Public Key = Point X | Point Y. The points are stor ed in little endian format. The number of bytes for the key depends on the implementation of the curve. Examples: NIST curve P(256) public key = X(32) | Y(32) NIST curve P(192) public key = X(24) | Y(24)
